title: Birds, Beaks, and a Lesson in Soft-Boiled Eggs
excerpt: I finally cracked the code on Singapore's Traditional Breakfast — literally — then spent the day lost among free-flying hornbills, flamingos, and a birthday-singing parrot at Bird Paradise.

photos.alt: A large pelican spreads its wings amid a crowd of pink flamingos during a keeper presentation at Bird Paradise, Singapore
A flock of pink flamingos wades in a shallow pool inside a large netted aviary with a rocky waterfall feature and lush trees behind
A tall artificial waterfall cascades between dramatic rocky cliffs at Bird Paradise, with two visitors standing at the base for scale
Scarlet ibises and roseate spoonbills perched on bare branches and in tall grass inside a sunlit walk-in aviary
Plate of fish and pasta at Penguin Cove Restaurant: battered fried fish over tomato spaghetti with steamed broccoli and cauliflower, penguin tank visible in the background
Design Orchard store front on Orchard Road at night, lit up with a large LED billboard advertising Bohème SG and Tala pop-ups
Colourful heritage shophouses along Emerald Hill at night, illuminated in warm yellows and reds with diners seated at outdoor tables
Classic Tapa King meal at a food court: fried egg, seasoned beef, and steamed rice on a white plate with a bowl of clear soup on a tray
Busy covered pedestrian strip on Orchard Road at night, lined with bar signs and packed with diners seated at outdoor tables
Interior entrance of TANGS department store on Orchard Road, with a Ferragamo pop-up display in the foreground and a glittering red facade
